findings.motion: SB 1174 Senate Third Reading, Assembly Floor
findings.note: She is listed as not voting on the Assembly floor vote on SB 1174, which bars local governments from requiring ID to vote at polling places (vote 57 yes, 16 no, 6 not voting, passed).

AB 1116 (Elections: voter registration) lets a person without a California driver's license or state ID register online by giving the last four digits of their Social Security number, with the Secretary of State checking identity from that number, name and birth date. She voted yes on Assembly third reading (60 yes, 18 no, 1 not voting, passed).
